name: Bohol International Marathon 2026
short_description: A full marathon and multi-distance race in Panglao, Bohol, Philippines, scheduled for August 30, 2026, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: The Bohol International Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon event scheduled for August 30, 2026, in Panglao, Bohol, Philippines. Organized by Bohol International Marathon, the race offers four distance options: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, catering to a range of runners from beginners to seasoned marathoners. Registration is currently open for participants interested in joining this Philippine race.
pros: Multiple distance options (42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, 5km) suit a range of runner abilities
Registration is currently open, giving ample time to prepare
Held in Panglao, Bohol, a notable Philippine destination

research_highlights: The course runs mainly along Panglao and Dauis roads and has been described by a 2018 finisher as well-paved with no potholes, appearing largely flat especially in the dark early hours.

The race starts before dawn (historically) to beat the heat; for 2026 a travel-agency preview notes the marathon starts shortly after midnight and that about 80% of the course is lit, with headlamps recommended.
Aid stations have featured local delicacies like lechon baka and lechon baboy alongside standard hydration, a distinctive Bohol/Sandugo Festival touch noted in 2024 coverage.
The 2025 edition (3rd installment) drew around 4,300 runners and used the TRACX live-tracking app so family/friends could follow progress via GPS.
Start/finish for recent editions has been at BE Grand Resort Bohol in Panglao, with race-kit collection typically held in the days just before the event.
research_watchouts: A 2018 participant reported minor logistics gaps, such as unclear signage for where finishers should collect their post-race entitlements.
One veteran finisher noted that despite high expectations, the event 'wasn't the run in paradise' as expected that year, suggesting organization/experience can vary by edition.

Much of the available online commentary is promotional event-preview content rather than independent runner reviews, so on-the-ground detail (heat, crowd support, cutoffs) is thin for the most recent 2024-2025 editions.

faqs.question: When is the Bohol International Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Bohol International Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 30, 2026. The event will be held in Panglao, Bohol, Philippines, and is organized by Bohol International Marathon, offering runners the chance to plan well ahead of the race day.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Bohol International Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Bohol International Marathon 2026 is currently open. Interested runners can sign up ahead of the race date on August 30, 2026, for any of the four available distances offered at this Philippines-based running event.

faqs.question: Where is the Bohol International Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The Bohol International Marathon 2026 is held in Panglao, Bohol, in the Philippines. This venue serves as the host location for all four race distances offered, including the full marathon, half marathon, 10km, and 5km events on August 30, 2026.

faqs.question: What distances can participants choose from in this race?
faqs.answer: Participants in the Bohol International Marathon 2026 can choose from four distances: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a 5km race, allowing runners of varying experience levels to take part.
